notes: GitHub is the authoritative source; connected GitHub tools only. No local files, checkouts, downloads or code execution.

This code reading scope is distinct from projects.json; exact identical blobs may reuse a full-text receipt with explicit source path and SHA. Historical/source-copy paths retain separate path receipts and placement labels.
Static reading observations are not confirmed runtime findings or test results.

Potential source-level auth-flow conflict to trace: (auth)/layout.tsx redirects any getUser() result to dashboard, while reset-password/page.tsx says it is reached after auth/callback exchanges recovery code for a session. Need inspect getUser(), callback/session helpers and reset action before judging; no runtime reproduction.

Builder/new is a GET that creates/reuses drafts. Its selected-template predicate checks publishedAt non-null but not lte now; template step uses lte new Date(). Potential future-publication consistency and duplicate draft race concerns require service/schema/route tracing. Event memories datetime-local fields use toISOString UTC slice; timezone interpretation must be checked in saveMemorySettings before judging user-facing time correctness.

Static copy/default discrepancy to trace: dashboard/account/page.tsx DEFAULT_PREFERENCES sets marketingEmails true, while preferences-form.tsx tells customers 'Off unless you ask.' Need schema and notification delivery policy before any behavioral/legal conclusion. No changes made.

Catalogue deletion source rechecks invitation count then deletes in separate database operations. catalogue.ts states Invitation.templateId onDelete:SetNull, so concurrent draft creation may defeat preservation intent; schema and concurrency tests needed, no reproduced runtime finding. Account and admin actions derive identities from session/requireStaff, while service/repository methods rely on guarded callers.

Dashboard overview derives attendingCount by counting attending response rows, not summing guestCount; source-level potential mismatch with Attending guest metric, to trace with RSVP intelligence. daysUntil uses server-local day boundaries despite viewer-boundary comment; event-zone behavior requires runtime/source investigation. Delivery readiness marks any existing order done regardless of order.status and always requires website+print; compare commerce entitlement rules before judging readiness correctness.
